messages.subject: [Zipfr-users] zipfr installation / loading error
messages.body_plain:
Hi!
I'm having some problems with the zipfr library. I used to work with it and
with Cairo library.
A few days ago, both of them stopped working. I reinstalled them but only
Cairo worked again.
ZipfR has been impossible to load.
Here I attach my R version, zipfR installation progress, and loading error.

Thanks in advance.

Best,
Marc
